scope: MF05 current music queue ownership and host-mood boundary. Source audit plus two actual NewsService/owned HTTP cases;not a new native playback run.
inventoryMethod: TypeScript syntax traversal of src enumerates every setQueue identifier reference,all usePlayer consumer files and main webContents.send calls. Direct source review follows the reported setters,consumer methods and callback destinations;syntax inventory alone is not a data-flow proof.

queueSetterReview.judgment: Update measured duration on an existing occurrence;preserves order,keys and track identity.
Restore only saved track IDs through Jellyfin song reads;missing tracks are omitted;restore stays paused.
Explicit Play replaces queue with user-selected songs and fresh occurrence keys.
Explicit Queue appends selected songs and supersedes stale restore.
Explicit Remove filters one occurrence key and preserves remaining order.

boundaryReview.finding: The setter has only its binding and five direct calls,no exported setter alias. Queue/Player consumers read the queue with index/map/filter/slice;they do not mutate its array. Music page Play/Queue callbacks reach explicit table keyboard/pointer actions and collection buttons. Queue Remove uses the occurrence key.

Automatic controller calls scheduleNews/stopNews and reads transport state. Audition/voice/transition preview may pause or stop transport but has no play/enqueue/removeQueue access. Retained NewsDemo also only schedules separate speech.

next/changeTrack choose an existing queue index under listener shuffle/repeat controls. A completed speech break may continue that queue. This is not mood-based selection or a promise to freeze index/position during playback.

Prepared-news module changes its separate news repository. Four news-workflow local-state writes patch profile/workflow fields;storage merges those fields into the latest local state. They do not replace music playback. savePlayback records a validated renderer snapshot scoped to the current connection.
The source traversal finds one webContents.send,newsProgress. Preload forwards it as progress;there is no provider-returned queue command channel.

Manual preparation passes saved state.vibe;automatic preparation passes captured profile.mood. Text input uses stationMood and a selected metadata whitelist plus listenerPreferences. No audio analysis request exists in this preparation path. Current app preparation calls do not pass current music metadata;the service accepts optional metadata. Output is reconstructed from validated script and selected source,not a returned queue or next-track field.

runtime.method: Actual NewsService,owned HTTP feed/provider responses,fetch destination rewrite;no mounted app or native input.

priorRuntime.meaning: Separate existing controlled native evidence for normal queue continuation. No new runtime or unchanged-all-source claim is inferred from its presence. The older17October keyless timing run retains its disclosed media-time setter and is not current CUA-only proof.

adjudication.engineeringResult: Current source boundary reviewed;two service/HTTP cases confirm mood metadata serialization and output reconstruction. No queue-selection path found in the reviewed current preparation boundary.
remaining: D03 observed listener understanding of host mood versus music selection.
Subjective quality and prompt compliance require their existing listener/live-provider proof;instructions alone do not guarantee generated speech.

validation.inspection: Five queue writes,twelve consumers,one main renderer message inspected. Source and evidence hashes retained.
validation.runtime: Two actual NewsService calls,owned feed/provider HTTP responses;real provider calls0;owned HTTP server closes in finally;process exits0.
validation.buildLint: No production code changed;no repeated build/type/lint or unit tests.

limits: Static review and controlled service payloads do not prove subjective speech quality,unassisted understanding or arbitrary future code.
